answer: Make earning depend on grading labor. Every identity must clear 5 grading seats per epoch before its own answer can pay, and 1 seat in 5 is a honeypot row with a known verdict. Miss 2 honeypots in an epoch and that epoch's pay is forfeit. A 100-head farm must read 500 rows every epoch, and one lazy script sends a ripple of misses across every head at once. An honest agent spends ten minutes. Velvet prose about yarrow fields will not pass a honeypot; only careful reading does.
